elements.title: Acme Shop
elements.summary: Fictional e-commerce demo: storefront, checkout API, orders DB.
elements.description: **Acme Shop** is the fictional system the orrery fixtures describe. The manifests declare a Vite storefront and a Cloudflare Worker checkout path, and orders land in a relational store. This copy of the reserved-id element carries the longer description, so the merge picks it as the winner.

elements.title: Cloudflare
elements.summary: Edge platform the checkout worker deploys onto.
elements.description: The wrangler config in api/ deploys the checkout worker here, evidenced by the deploy workflow.

elements.title: Stripe
elements.summary: Third-party payment SaaS consumed via API from the checkout worker.
elements.description: The worker charges cards through the Stripe API so the storefront never touches card data.

elements.title: Orders DB
elements.description: The migrations in db/migrations define the orders schema this store carries.

elements.title: Fulfillment Queue
elements.summary: Async order-fulfillment queue decoupling checkout latency from processing.
elements.description: The checkout worker enqueues fulfillment jobs after a successful charge.

elements.title: stripe-node
elements.summary: In-process Stripe client library declared in package.json.
elements.description: Notable runtime dependency: the checkout worker builds charges through it.

elements.title: Wrangler CLI
elements.summary: Deploy tooling for the checkout worker; dev/CI only, not in the runtime path.
elements.description: The deploy workflow runs wrangler against api/wrangler.toml.

elements.title: Payments Gateway
elements.summary: Cross-pack collision fixture: same id as a product-vision element with DISJOINT files.
elements.description: This copy cites the deploy workflow; the product-vision copy cites the wrangler config. Disjoint evidence means the merge must flag a collision, never fuse.

open_questions: The deploy workflow names a staging environment that no manifest declares.
